(Retrieved via WebFetch; condensed by fetch tool)

Kuwait: Kuwaiti officials confirmed Iran struck a power and water desalination facility. The Ministry of Electricity, Water and Renewable Energy stated the attack "sparked a fire, damaging a large number of electricity generation" units. Citizens were urged to ration power until restoration efforts complete. Approximately 90 percent of Kuwait's water originates from desalination plants.

Casualties:
- One child injured in Qatar by falling shrapnel
- Eight people killed in US strikes on Iranian civilian infrastructure
- Iran reports 38 total deaths and over 400 wounded from US attacks since late June

IRGC claimed responsibility for targeting:
- Bahrain: US helicopters and reconnaissance aircraft at Sakhir airbase
- Qatar: Al Udeid Air Base (unconfirmed by US or Qatar)
- Jordan: three missiles shot down; no casualties reported
- Oman: US monitoring assets including air control and maritime surveillance radars
- Syria: Al-Tanf military base (CENTCOM rejected this claim as "false")

No named Gulf state officials provided direct quotes in this reporting.
